comment: Folio compiler fallback profile: deliberately ALLOW-everything. Docker's default seccomp profile blocks clone/unshare with user-namespace flags for unprivileged users on some hosts, which keeps the compiler's per-job bubblewrap sandbox from working (the boot probe then reports isolation=none). This profile trades default-seccomp filtering for per-job namespace isolation. NOT wired into any compose file; see deploy/seccomp-README.md before using it.
